about: 0.91 V6.4: TensorRT-LLM 1.2.0 perf-overview (version-pinned URL), B200 FP4 and H200 FP8 columns for catalog models, verbatim per row; metric = output tok/s per GPU at max load (uniform synthetic ISL/OSL, concurrency -1).
